title: Hotel California Dragon
description: A hiker with a backpack and walking stick stands at the edge of a winding turquoise river that flows through a desert landscape filled with purple flowers. In the river floats a large purple crystal ball containing multiple surreal eyes and faces, while a colorful dragon perches on the iconic Hotel California building with a castle visible on the mountain behind it.
prompt: A detailed surreal fantasy scene featuring a large colorful dragon with purple and orange scales perched on the roof of the Hotel California building, a winding turquoise river flowing through a desert with purple lavender fields, a hiker with backpack and walking stick standing by the water, and a large purple crystal ball floating in the river containing multiple surreal eyes and faces, with a castle on a rocky mountain in the background under a starry twilight sky with a comet, in a vibrant illustrative painting style.
